Before the test

Agree the participants
and evidence.

01

Importer + broker

An importer compliance owner, a participating broker, and counsel where the lane requires it.

02

Ten recurring SKUs

Permissioned historical product facts, invoices, origin and valuation evidence, and prior-entry references.

03

One selected offer

An explicit recurring job, a bounded deliverable, and an agreed review method—not an assumed five-offer bundle.

The evaluation method

Prior entries are
a comparison, not ground truth.

Record broker-reviewed reasoning and any counsel escalation. Measure the same defined preparation and review tasks before and during the pilot, separately for the importer and broker.

What will be measured

Outcomes are still open.

01

Broker-accepted dossiers

Explicit acceptance for preparation, with reasons for rejection.

Not yet measured
02

Material disagreements

Reviewer-documented differences in classification, valuation, origin, or screening handling.

Not yet measured
03

Missing evidence

Type and count of product, origin, and valuation gaps.

Not yet measured
04

Time & rework

The same task definition, measured separately for importer and broker.

Not yet measured
05

Unresolved holds

Reason, owner, and age; export never removes a hold.

Not yet measured
06

False positives & omissions

Reviewer-labeled cases and denominator; no self-reported AI accuracy.

Not yet measured
07

Paid commitment

Signed scope and agreed terms; interest and clicks are separate.

Not yet measured

A real decision gate

Proceed on evidence.
Stop when the job is already solved.

Proceed only when the broker incorporates dossiers, the importer funds the lane pilot, a permissioned SKU feed is usable, and legal/data licensing review permits the work. Halt if maintainable data or lane coverage is missing, error modes undermine use, or the current broker process suffices.

Hypothetical test pricing

$3,000 / ten-SKU pilot

Scope and commercial acceptance remain to be validated. No payment is collected.
